description: This file defines a Flutter widget hierarchy for a dashboard screen in a mobile application. It includes UI components such as header, promo card, feature tiles, poster carousel, and bottom navigation, styled with specific colors and layout consistent with a dark theme.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the dashboard screen, containing the scaffold layout with various UI sections and bottom navigation.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing dynamic aspects like selected bottom navigation index.

classes.name: _HeaderRow
classes.description: Stateless widget representing the header row with greeting and action icons.

classes.name: _CircleOutlineIconButton
classes.description: Icon button with circular outline, used for search and notifications.

classes.name: _HeroPromoCard
classes.description: Promotional card with gradient background, text, and 'Watch now' button.

classes.name: _HeroXGlowPainter
classes.description: Custom painter rendering stylized 'X' glow and sparkles around it.

classes.name: _SectionTitle
classes.description: Widget for section titles like 'Featured' and 'Curated for you'.

classes.name: _FeaturedTilesRow
classes.description: Row of feature tiles like Rewards, Tickets, Gifts, Deals.

classes.name: _FeaturedTile
classes.description: Individual feature tile with icon and label.

classes.name: _PosterCard
classes.description: Widget representing a poster with gradient background and optional close icon overlay.

classes.name: _BottomNavBar
classes.description: Bottom navigation bar with four icons.

classes.name: _NavIcon
classes.description: Individual icon in the bottom navigation, indicating active/inactive state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for UI layout inside various widgets.
